content: Aaradhya Verma reached out to insurance agent Neha Kapoor to inquire about a 10% premium increase on her policy renewal. Neha explained that the increase is due to inflation, but highlighted that pre-existing condition coverage has been increased to 70% alongside a new chronic disease management feature. Satisfied with the updates, Aaradhya agreed to proceed and requested a digital signature link for the renewal form.

action_items: Send digital signature link for the renewal form to the customer
